displayName: 太阳（日托看护者） Sun (Daycare Attendant)
description: Unofficial Sun (Daycare Attendant) fan-art animated companion inspired by Five Nights at Freddy’s. This friendly, fully covered cartoon toy adaptation retains seven broad head rays and the darker anatomical-left facial section. Original gentle activities include arranging and recovering three foam blocks, touching a paper crescent with a wrist bell, rolling a paper strip, a low hop and articulated steps. Props are soft display models and the appearance contains no frightening transformation. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
